record_title: Sharp Simes size under pairwise independence for three uniform p-values
provenance: An exact extremal probability theorem for the three-hypothesis Simes event under pairwise-independent uniform null p-values, with explicit sharp constructions.
limitations: Specific to three exactly uniform null p-values; does not characterize m>=4, super-uniform non-uniform nulls, partial-null FDR, or higher limited-independence orders. Equivalent formulations may exist in older Bonferroni, copula, or extremal probability literature.
